## Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo API

Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo is an image generation and image editing model by Alibaba Qwen, available on the Venice API as `qwen-image-2-1-turbo`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

### Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `qwen-image-2-1-turbo` | Generate | Anonymized | $0.02 / image |
| `qwen-image-2-1-turbo-edit` | Edit | Anonymized | $0.02 / edit |

### Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Alibaba Qwen |
| Released | Oct 9, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Resolutions | 1K, 2K |
| Aspect ratios | 1:1, 3:2, 16:9, 21:9, 9:16, 2:3, 3:4, 4:5 |
| Prompt limit | 10,000 characters |

### How to use the Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate` with `"model": "qwen-image-2-1-turbo"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "qwen-image-2-1-turbo",
    "prompt": "A retro travel poster with the bold headline \"VENICE\" in large condensed serif type, sunset color palette",
    "resolution": "1K",
    "aspect_ratio": "1:1"
  }'
```
